cancun.luogo: Cancún is in the state of Quintana Roo (municipality of Benito Juárez), so foreign visitors pay the state Visitax there.
faq: Do I have to pay the Cancún tourist tax?

Yes, if you are a foreign visitor. The Visitax is mandatory for all foreign tourists who visit Quintana Roo, according to the official Visitax portal and article 51-Octies of the Quintana Roo Law on Fees. Mexican nationals do not pay it.
When do I pay the Visitax for Cancún?

The law says foreign visitors must pay it when they enter the state. The official portal asks for your arrival date, departure date and the passport of each traveller, and gives a QR code for each person that you can download again with 'Recover your receipt'.

tulum.luogo: Tulum is in the state of Quintana Roo (municipality of Tulum), so foreign visitors pay the state Visitax there.
faq: Is the Tulum tourist tax the same as in Cancún?

Yes. The tourist fee for foreign visitors in Tulum is the Quintana Roo Visitax, the same state fee as in Cancún. Stays in Quintana Roo are also subject to the state lodging tax: {alloggio}% of the lodging price, or {alloggio_case}% for houses, apartments and villas.

playa-del-carmen.luogo: Playa del Carmen is in the state of Quintana Roo (municipality of Solidaridad), so foreign visitors pay the state Visitax there.
faq: Is the Playa del Carmen tourist tax different from Cancún?
No. Playa del Carmen and Cancún are both in Quintana Roo, and the Visitax is a state fee with one amount for the whole state.

cozumel.luogo: Cozumel is an island municipality of Quintana Roo, so foreign visitors who stay there pay the state Visitax. The official Visitax portal says it applies to Cozumel, whatever way you leave.
faq: Do cruise passengers pay the Visitax in Cozumel?

Cruise passengers pay a different state fee: US${crociere_usd} per passenger, charged when they buy the cruise ticket (article 51-Nonies of the Quintana Roo Law on Fees). Paying it exempts them from the Visitax, and it is charged only at the first Quintana Roo port of the trip. Crew members are exempt.
